summary.name: Valmera
summary.one_liner: Valmera is an agentic AI video editor that edits uploaded footage from plain-English requests, in a browser studio or through an MCP connection to an AI assistant.
use_cases: Turning long talks or podcasts into vertical short clips
Removing silences and filler words from a recording
Reframing wide footage to 9:16 with speaker-following crop
Editing video from an AI assistant over MCP
Exporting finished MP4 files for social platforms
summary.what_it_does: Valmera takes an uploaded video (MP4, MOV, M4V, WebM or MKV) and edits it from natural-language instructions. It indexes the recording with a word-timed transcript, shots and silences, then makes cuts, adds captions, reframes to other aspect ratios, applies color grades, zooms and motion graphics, and renders a preview for review. Users can review the timeline and editable transcript, correct transcription errors and request further changes through chat. The final MP4 is created in Studio from the original upload. Users can also connect Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or another MCP client to its hosted server to inspect footage, call editing tools and export.
notable: Connects to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or other MCP clients via OAuth
Finds complete stories in long talks and cuts them into shorts
Word-timed captions and motion graphics such as animated counters and list builds
Free tier exports carry a watermark and end card
caveats: Agent editing requires a paid subscription: Plus $15/month (500 credits, includes MCP), Pro $50/month (1,500 credits), Max $100/month (4,000 credits)
Studio burns captions into video and does not import or export SRT/VTT subtitle files
Users must download and publish MP4s to social platforms themselves
AI edits are not guaranteed correct; the page advises checking cuts, captions, framing and audio
